title: Nutrient-Rich Peruvian Duck Arroz Con Pato
description: A flavorful, one-pot dish from Peru, featuring duck, vegetables, and a tangy lacquer glaze.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large comal or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast until browned on both sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the comal and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced aji amarillo peppers and cook for 2 minutes, until slightly softened.
Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat the rice in the oil and mix with the vegetables.
Add the chicken broth, hoisin sauce, HP sauce, soy sauce, and soaked saffron threads to the comal.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the duck breast to the comal, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the duck is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
